title: Print hello world
description: Write a program that prints Hello, World! to the console.

title: Sum of array
description: Given an array of integers, return the sum of all elements. Simple iteration.

title: Two sum
description: Given an array and a target, return indices of two numbers that add up to target. Use a hash map.

title: FizzBuzz
description: Print numbers 1 to n, replacing multiples of 3 and 5. Classic beginner problem.

title: Reverse a string
description: Return the reversed version of the input string.

title: Valid parentheses
description: Given a string of brackets, determine if it is valid using a stack.

title: Binary search
description: Find the target in a sorted array using binary search. Compare middle element.

title: Merge two sorted lists
description: Merge two sorted linked lists into one sorted list. Use two pointers.

title: Climbing stairs
description: Count the number of ways to climb n stairs taking 1 or 2 steps. Dynamic programming.

title: Longest increasing subsequence
description: Find the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence using DP.

title: Dijkstra shortest path
description: Find shortest paths from a source node in a weighted graph using Dijkstra. Use a priority queue.

title: Word ladder
description: Transform start word to end word by changing one letter at a time, each step a valid word. BFS over graph of words.

title: Edit distance
description: Compute the minimum operations to convert one string to another with insert, delete, replace. Dynamic programming with 2D table.

title: Maximum flow
description: Compute the maximum flow in a flow network using the Ford-Fulkerson method with BFS augmenting paths. Advanced graph algorithm.

title: Traveling salesman DP
description: Find the shortest route visiting every city exactly once and returning to start using bitmask dynamic programming. NP hard optimization.

title: Convex hull
description: Compute the convex hull of a set of 2D points using Graham scan with sorting and cross product orientation checks. Computational geometry.

title: Segment tree range query
description: Build a segment tree supporting range sum and point updates. Advanced data structure with recursive merge.

title: Counting sort
description: Sort an array of integers in a known small range using counting sort.

title: Topological sort
description: Order the nodes of a directed acyclic graph so that edges point forward. Use Kahn's algorithm with indegree tracking.

title: Knapsack 0/1
description: Maximize value with a weight limit choosing each item at most once. Dynamic programming over items and capacity.
